sources.title: subtask readme
sources.finding: Subtask gives a leading Claude Code session a product skill/CLI to draft tasks, launch parallel workers in Git worktrees, inspect conversations/diffs, request changes and merge locally.

sources.title: subtask pkg/harness/claude.go
sources.finding: Launches claude with print/stream-json, permission mode and optional resume ID; parses result/session events.

sources.title: subtask pkg/harness/codex.go
sources.finding: Launches codex exec --json with bypass flags, optional model/effort and resume; parses JSONL and final output.

sources.title: subtask pkg/harness/opencode.go
sources.finding: Launches opencode run --format json with optional model/variant/agent/session and stdin prompt.

sources.title: subtask pkg/install/SKILL.md
sources.finding: Product skill distinguishes draft from send, follows worker output, sends revisions and squash-merges. Human merge sign-off is an instruction to the lead, not proof of CLI-enforced authorization.

sources.title: subtask pkg/tui/changes_render.go
sources.locator: renderDiffView lines16-31; renderChangesDiffPane lines152-231; renderUnifiedRowLines lines239-305
sources.finding: TUI Changes file pane renders actual diff row.Text in unified or side-by-side layouts with code styling and line numbers.

sources.title: subtask pkg/tui/view_detail.go
sources.finding: Task detail Changes tab invokes renderDiffView; conversations and conflicts have their own tabs.

sources.title: subtask pkg/task/ops/merge.go
sources.locator: MergeTask preconditions; conflict preflight lines198-217; squash operations
sources.finding: Local merge requires a clean worker checkout, calculates merge base, checks conflicts, squashes work and updates task merged state. No human identity approval gate was established.
